cili.name: CILI
cili.summary: Trusted in mamak stalls, restaurants and food service outlets across Malaysia. Strong, absorbent and reliable — every sheet is made to handle real meals, real fast.

wasabi.name: WASABI
wasabi.summary: Available in 50g and 200g formats, Wasabi serviettes are the go-to choice for street food and Thai-food operators who need value they can count on.

unisoft.name: UNISOFT
unisoft.summary: Beautifully soft and made for everyone. Unisoft facial tissues bring universal softness and gentle daily care to homes, offices and communities of all ages.

aimishu.name: AIMISHU
aimishu.summary: A playful I-miss-you-inspired name with practical hanging convenience. Aimishu hanging tissues bring comfort, care and character to every corner of your day.

babylike.name: BabyLike
babylike.summary: Thoughtful care for delicate skin. Comfort and dryness for happy babies, day and night.

sumo.name: SUMO
sumo.summary: Reliable protection and dignity for active days and restful nights.
